This is hymn number 332 titled "O God, Our Help in Ages Past" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in G Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by William Croft and the lyrics were written by Isaac Watts.
